portraits.name: Le hall d'entrée · The entrance hall
portraits.alt: The sunny entrance hall of the portrait gallery: a woman shows a family snapshot, a lady in pearls rings the desk bell, a young flower seller blows a kiss, a lady with a parasol passes the beaver's dam in the fountain, a mother carries her son, the owner jingles his keys, a man meditates under the stairs, a gentleman finds paint on his white suit, a delivery guy wobbles his parcels, an old lord comes down the stairs, a group sets off with picnic baskets and a neighbor carries sunflowers.

doors.label: Les âges
doors.hint: the sky-blue door with the rocking horse, to the hall of ages

doors.label: L'atelier
doors.hint: the rose-pink door with the mirror, to the portrait studio

doors.hint: the sage-green door with the two masks, to the character parlor

doors.hint: the grand staircase, up to the landing

ages.name: La salle des âges · The hall of ages
ages.alt: A sunny conservatory full of birthdays and ages: geese fly past in a V, a girl skateboards hugging a plush sea monster, cousins in jester hats crowd together, a child bounces on a hopper ball, a toddler swims in a grown-up suit, a boy wears a paper guard helmet, grandpa blows out his birthday candles, a penguin in a red scarf stands on the shelf, a farmer watches a bee, a glowing being offers a tray of lemonade, a boy speeds by on a scooter, a teenager lounges on a beanbag and a purple tapestry shows a whole crowd of people.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: the sky-blue door with the rocking horse, back to the entrance hall

apparences.name: L'atelier des portraits · The portrait studio
apparences.alt: A skylit painting studio on portrait class day: a cute kitten sleeps in a basket of onions, a baby bunny peeks from a cardboard house, a tired painter dozes on his stool, a jolly grandma poses with lilies, a mouse peers through a magnifying glass, a seagull swoops in with a greasy pizza slice, a famous singer bows in confetti, a lion has its blond mane blow-dried, a lively puppy runs off with a bone, two lost ducklings huddle under a fern and a boy paints a black profile.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: the rose-pink door with the mirror, back to the entrance hall

caracteres.name: Le salon des caractères · The character parlor
caracteres.alt: A cozy wood-paneled parlor on family game night: a girl with crossed arms sticks her nose in the air, a tanned man licks an ice-cream cone, a tin robot points at two little boys sharing a big armchair, one in a paper crown, a peacock fans its tail by the fire, a hen sits by a sack of eggs, one polka-dot zebra stands among striped ones on the mantel, a girl hugs her padlocked diary, a charming man kisses a granny's hand and a pug glares at a goldfish jar.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: the sage-green door with the masks, back to the entrance hall

doors.label: Le courage
doors.hint: the orange door with the trophy cup, to the courage gym

courage.name: La salle du courage · The courage gym
courage.alt: A small wooden gym on obstacle-course day: a tiny hamster stands up to a barking dog, a shy rabbit peeks from behind a big blue teapot, a friendly koala pats a boy and holds a tray of cookies, a toddler with a shiny pendant climbs the rope ladder alone, a dove leaps into the foam pit, and a grandma gymnast in a frilly pink leotard twirls a ribbon, while a coach, a toy-soldier general and a trainer cheer at the right.

doors.label: Le salon
doors.hint: the orange door with the trophy cup, back to the character parlor

palier.name: Le palier · The upstairs landing
palier.alt: The sunny upstairs landing on family reunion day: at the top of the staircase a girl stitches a quilt of many hands holding the globe, a girl balances a stack of tin cans on her head, a granny rocks in her chair with a brass horn, a blind man with a white cane and guide dog plays a bugle, a little kid in a big apron pushes a doll buggy, an older brother gives a piggyback, an old man holds up a long scarf, a gentleman in a bowler hat offers his umbrella and a footman bows with a tray.

doors.label: Le hall
doors.hint: the staircase, down to the entrance hall

doors.label: La coiffure
doors.hint: the teal door with the scissors, to the hair salon

doors.label: Les cartes
doors.hint: the navy door with the compass rose, to the map room

doors.hint: the red door with the treasure chest, to the treasure room

doors.label: La salle à manger
doors.hint: the yellow door with the soup tureen, to the dining room

coiffure.name: Le salon de coiffure · The hair salon
coiffure.alt: A tiled hair salon on Saturday morning: a woman has a lock pulled through her mesh cap, a red kangaroo sits in a barber chair, a bald man playfully shoves the barber, a boy cheers his new buzz cut, a bluebird pops out of a bushy beard, a curly girl sculpts a blue clay head, a boy laughs at a comic under the hood dryer, a grandma with purple hair waves, and a beautician matches a man's complexion with a powder palette.

doors.label: Le palier
doors.hint: the teal door with the scissors, back to the landing

doors.label: L'attente
doors.hint: the green door with the hourglass, to the waiting room

cartes.name: La salle des cartes · The map room
cartes.alt: A cozy map room on a family geography afternoon: a girl catches a paper plane in a butterfly net by the globe, a woman pours maple syrup on pancakes, a boy yawns by a little Big Ben model, a mother in a gray headband points at North Africa on the wall map, a girl holds a toy balloon rising from a map pin, a grandpa sews a family-tree quilt, and a smiling man spreads postcards across the map table while a cat sleeps among rolled maps.

doors.label: Le palier
doors.hint: the navy door with the compass rose, back to the landing

tresors.name: La salle des trésors · The treasure room
tresors.alt: A red treasure room on open day: a golden doe stands in a ray of light, a little dragon flies out of a storybook, a tiny ant lifts a golden trophy, giant spectacles float over a pedestal, a pink chameleon sits on a green plant, two jelly blobs look alike, a girl plays a glass harp while a family watches, a seal holds a jigsaw piece, and a sky-blue door with a compass rose opens onto a sunny travel lounge.

doors.label: Le palier
doors.hint: the red door with the treasure chest, back to the landing

doors.label: Les voyages
doors.hint: the sky-blue door with the compass rose, to the travel lounge

attente.name: La salle d'attente · The waiting room
attente.alt: The salon's yellow waiting room on a busy Saturday: a bored boy slumps in an armchair, a man checks his watch, a lady gulps orange juice on the run, a sloth sleeps on the coat rack, a little boy reaches toward a shaggy sheepdog, a messy-haired man kneels and begs, a clumsy boy knocks over a magazine stack, a girl devours a magazine, another climbs to the top shelf, a boy raises his hand and a tortoise in a scarf waits on a chair.

doors.label: La coiffure
doors.hint: the green door with the hourglass, back to the hair salon

salle.name: La salle à manger · The dining room
salle.alt: A warm green dining room at Sunday lunch: a boy hands his slice of pie to his sister, a girl holds out a marble, a grandma wraps a guest in a shawl, a boy hands back a wallet, another holds his hand on his heart, a boy waves a friend over, a grandpa shows his antique gramophone, another pours lemonade, a girl hugs a raccoon, an old man reads by the fire and a cat sits at the table with a napkin. A yellow door with a soup tureen leads back to the landing; tall open French doors under an ivy garland lead out to the garden party.

doors.label: Le palier
doors.hint: the yellow door with the soup tureen, back to the landing

doors.label: Le jardin
doors.hint: the open French doors under the ivy garland, out to the garden party

voyages.name: Le salon des voyages · The travel lounge
voyages.alt: A sunny ochre travel lounge with old maps and suitcases: a girl opens a bento box by a flag of Japan, a woman pours tea by a flag of India, a boy holds a pelota ball and wicker glove, a man carries a tower of crêpes near a black-and-white Breton flag, a girl in a mauve dress hugs lavender beside a toy van full of lavender, a boy kicks a ball past a crowing rooster, and a tortoise with a backpack crosses the rug.

doors.label: Les trésors
doors.hint: the sky-blue door with the compass rose, back to the treasure room

doors.label: La véranda
doors.hint: the green glass door with the fern, to the veranda

doors.label: La garde-robe
doors.hint: the pink door with the coat hanger, to the dressing room

veranda.name: La véranda · The glass veranda
veranda.alt: A sunny glass veranda with ferns and a lemon tree: a teenage girl with headphones sits on a hanging swing, a small kid plays ghost under a sheet, a girl hugs a raccoon, a boy yawns at a dull slideshow, a grandpa rests in his wicker armchair with cocoa, a jolly man eats cream cake, a man in a striped sweater opens the garden door with open arms, and a peacock fans his tail beside a peahen.

doors.label: Les voyages
doors.hint: the green glass door with the fern, back to the travel lounge

doors.label: Le salon de thé
doors.hint: the white door with the blue teacup, to the tea room

the.name: Le salon de thé · The tea room
the.alt: A cozy pale-blue tea room with lace tables and a cake counter: a man piles whipped cream on a girl's hot chocolate, a lady in pearls sips tea, a girl cuts a cake with a ruler, a blue jay pecks a boy's scone, a man taps a barometer pointing to the sun, a waitress balances a tray of cups, two men shake hands by a jug of red cordial, and a mouse nibbles a sugar cube.

doors.label: La véranda
doors.hint: the white door with the blue teacup, back to the veranda

garde.name: La garde-robe · The dressing room
garde.alt: A rose-striped dressing room with clothes rails and hat boxes: twin girls in matching yellow polka-dot dresses, a mannequin in a half-sewn jacket, a chubby boy with two éclairs and a plate of pastries, a scowling boy in an ugly snowman sweater, a girl in a golden cape and medal on a stool, a skinny grayhound in a knitted coat growling, a cat asleep in a hat box, and a mauve door with gold stars open onto a rehearsal stage.

doors.label: Les voyages
doors.hint: the pink door with the coat hanger, back to the travel lounge

doors.label: La répétition
doors.hint: the mauve door with the gold stars, to the rehearsal room

repetition.name: La salle de répétition · The rehearsal room
repetition.alt: A theater rehearsal room with red velvet curtains and a painted castle backdrop: a girl in overalls reaches up to a big tear in the curtain, a magician pulls a striped sock from his top hat, a boy knight holds up a floppy cheese stick, a boy-king in a paper crown sulks in a shabby prop rowboat, a stage manager in a headset presses the red button on the clock, a girl in a red tracksuit stretches by a fizzing soda bottle, a smiling lady chats on a rotary phone, a child kneels by a kitten in a basket, and a mouse in a tutu stands on the piano.

doors.label: La garde-robe
doors.hint: the mauve door with the gold stars, back to the dressing room

doors.label: Les timbres
doors.hint: the teal door with the postage stamp, to the stamp room

timbres.name: Le cabinet des timbres · The stamp room
timbres.alt: A pale green stamp club room with a big framed world map and a round oak table covered with stamp albums and magnifying glasses. A boy in a yellow sweater waves a Swedish flag and sings; a girl holds a pot of shamrocks by an Irish flag; a mother spreads a batik cloth by a Malaysian flag; a girl unrolls an old map of Gaul with round huts; a boy holds a can with a cactus by a Mexican flag; a girl holds up a patchwork quilt; a farmer shows a cheese box and a toy cow by the red Normandy flag with two gold lions; a gruff clerk stamps an envelope at the counter, where a pigeon holds a postcard. A teal door with a crown stamp opens onto the rehearsal room; a white door with silver bells opens onto a wedding hall.

doors.label: La répétition
doors.hint: the teal door with the postage stamp, back to the rehearsal room

doors.label: Les noces
doors.hint: the white door with the silver bell, to the wedding hall

noces.name: La salle des noces · The wedding hall
noces.alt: A cream town-hall wedding room with a black-and-white checkered floor and a white flower arch topped by two doves. A bride and groom hold hands under the arch; a stately grandfather in a blue sash watches; a boy hands a lost wallet back to a grateful gentleman; a girl in pink reaches toward a chocolate fountain on the lemonade table; a gardener bows with his cap in hand; an old couple claps side by side. A flower girl carries the rings, a grandmother sits on a bench, an uncle holds an umbrella under a dripping skylight and an old white horse in a flower crown looks in at the window. A white door with silver bells opens onto the stamp room; a green double door with a white chess knight leads on.

doors.label: Les timbres
doors.hint: the white door with the silver bells, back to the stamp room

doors.label: Le club
doors.hint: the green door with the chess knight, to the games club

club.name: Le club de jeux · The games club
club.alt: A blue games club room with board games, beanbags, a round window and a ping-pong table. A girl stacks a tall domino tower; a green parrot chatters on its perch above a bored boy; a boy pushes tin soldiers and toy cannons across a play mat; a hedgehog bristles at a wind-up robot; a girl who won the board game smiles shyly while two boys clap; a boy at a card table has a card sliding out of his sleeve while friends gasp; a boy in a helmet and knee pads plays ping-pong; a boy in yellow juggles three balls. A green double door with white chess knights opens onto the wedding hall; a yellow door with a red hammer and a blue paintbrush leads on to the crafts workshop.

doors.label: Les noces
doors.hint: the green door with the chess knight, back to the wedding hall

doors.label: L'atelier
doors.hint: the yellow door with the hammer and paintbrush, to the crafts workshop

atelier.name: L'atelier des bricoleurs · The crafts workshop
atelier.alt: A bright crafts workshop with whitewashed brick walls, a pegboard of tools and one long workbench down the middle under skylights. A girl in purple sands a little wooden sailboat; a boy slides a drawer into a small cabinet; a girl at the back sorts screws into a row of glass jars; a grinning boy dangles a big rubber spider over the bench; a girl in pink paints her carved wooden duck bright orange; two lovebirds snuggle in a hanging cage; a delivery man staggers under a huge parcel by a stack of boxes topped with a rocking horse; a teen pretends to sleep in a hammock by a leaning broom. A yellow door with a red hammer and a blue paintbrush leads back to the games club; a blue arched door with a golden music note leads on to the village chapel.

doors.label: Le club
doors.hint: the yellow door with the hammer and paintbrush, back to the games club

doors.label: La chapelle
doors.hint: the pale blue door with the golden music note, to the village chapel

chapelle.name: La chapelle · The village chapel
chapelle.alt: A small whitewashed village chapel with wooden pews, a lectern, tall clear windows onto green fields and a little pipe organ. Children in white robes sing on the left; a woman speaks warmly at the lectern; an old woman and a man in a plain gray coat sipping water sit in the front pews; a boy tiptoes down the aisle with a finger to his lips; an old man prays quietly in his pew; the organist lets a toddler press the keys; a gentleman in a top hat tucks in a newborn's blanket as the mother cradles the baby; a sparrow listens on the window latch. A blue door with a golden music note leads back to the crafts workshop.

doors.label: L'atelier
doors.hint: the pale blue door with the golden music note, back to the crafts workshop

jardin.name: Le jardin · The garden party
jardin.alt: A sunny back-garden family party with a red-and-white striped tent, bunting and apple trees. A bulldog hides from a butterfly behind a flower pot; a little boy pats his pregnant mother's tummy on a bench; a crush of sheep and a cow push through the hedge; a lady in a flowered hat goes cross-eyed at a ladybug on her nose; a man in a city suit steps into a muddy puddle; a teen in headphones kneads dough; a boy in blue jeans strides out through the thorny rose hedge without a scratch; grandma slips a toddler a cupcake; grandpa carries a mountain of sausages; another grandpa hops in a sack race; a big uncle pulls a fraying tug-of-war rope; a hen in a paper party hat sits on a wheelbarrow. Open French doors lead back to the dining room, a blue gate with a rosette leads to the pet show and stone steps rise to the ballroom's glass doors.

doors.label: La salle à manger
doors.hint: the French doors under the ivy garland, back to the dining room

doors.label: La salle de bal
doors.hint: the stone steps and glass doors, up to the ballroom

doors.label: Le concours
doors.hint: the blue garden gate with the rosette, to the pet show

bal.name: La salle de bal · The ballroom
bal.alt: A grand cream-and-gold ballroom with a crystal chandelier, gilt mirrors, a parquet floor and a little band by a grand piano. A boy spreads his jacket over a puddle of spilled pink punch for a girl in pink; a lady waltzes in a huge blue hat topped by a splashing fountain and a toy sailboat; a man twirls his mustache at his own reflection in a gilt mirror; a boy in a sailor suit swings from the chandelier; a little girl in lilac kneels and pleads with her father, who checks his pocket watch; a wild-haired violinist plays on; a rich old man pours gold coins into a top hat; a waiter brings a platter of prawns; a little dog in a bow tie dances on its hind legs. Tall arched glass doors lead back down to the garden; white double doors with gilt panels lead on to the picture gallery.

doors.label: Le jardin
doors.hint: the arched glass doors, back down to the garden

doors.label: La galerie
doors.hint: the white doors with gilt frames, to the picture gallery

galerie.name: La galerie de tableaux · The picture gallery
galerie.alt: A long picture gallery with deep red walls, gilt-framed paintings, marble busts, a velvet rope and a glass skylight. A girl at an easel copies a windmill-village landscape; a boy on a step stool polishes the marble bust of a bearded scholar; an old man with a curly white mustache stands beside a portrait of himself as a young man, which tips off the wall toward a visitor whose face goes pale; a guard flaps his cap at a pigeon; a white cat sleeps on a red velvet sofa; a big portrait of a gray cat watches two children; a puppy hugs a laughing girl's ankle. White double doors with gilt panels lead back to the ballroom; a green door with a golden lyre leads on to the music room.

doors.label: La salle de bal
doors.hint: the white doors with gilt frames, back to the ballroom

doors.label: Le salon de musique
doors.hint: the green door with the golden lyre, to the music room

concours.name: Le concours d'animaux · The pet show
concours.alt: A village pet show on a sunny lawn inside a white picket ring hung with rosettes, with bunting, straw bales and hills and a church tower beyond. A little gray pony plants its hooves and refuses the pink tutu a girl holds out; a spotted dog sprawls on a heap of tennis balls while a dachshund and a poodle look on; a golden puppy leaps for joy; a girl raises a prawn and a terrier springs up for it while a boy holds its leash; a basset hound lies flat by the fence; on the judges' table a gray cat yawns as a judge pins on its blue rosette; a rooster crows on a rock by the tent and a goose in a rosette struts by. A yellow-and-white striped bake-sale tent stands open at the right. An open blue garden gate with a blue-and-gold rosette leads back to the garden party.

doors.label: Le jardin
doors.hint: the blue garden gate with the rosette, back to the garden party

doors.label: La tente des gâteaux
doors.hint: the striped tent with its flaps tied open, to the bake sale

musique.name: Le salon de musique · The music room
musique.alt: A sunny pale-blue music room with white wainscoting, a parquet floor and a tall window onto apple trees. A tiny girl on a tall stack of cushions plays the black grand piano; a boy holds his violin upside down at a music stand; a stern teacher with a gray bun holds up a metronome; a boy in an explorer hat climbs a golden harp; a girl in yellow flings her arms wide and sings as papers fly; a boy plays a drum kit; a girl polishes a trumpet beside a heap of cloths. A green door with a golden lyre leads back to the red picture gallery, and a pink door with a gold teapot stands open onto a pink tea salon with a chandelier.

doors.label: La galerie
doors.hint: the green door with the golden lyre, back to the picture gallery

doors.label: Le salon de thé
doors.hint: the pink door with the gold teapot, to the tea salon

tente.name: La tente des gâteaux · The bake-sale tent
tente.alt: Inside a yellow-and-white striped bake-sale tent with bunting, long white-clothed tables of cakes, pies, cupcakes and cookies, and grass underfoot. A smiling boy in an apron cuts a big chocolate cake; a red squirrel makes off with a pink cupcake; a towering rainbow layer cake wears a gold rosette; a girl in a red dress crunches a big cookie; a judge in a straw hat peers through a magnifying glass at two identical cherry pies; a man waves a napkin at bees while ladies sip tea; a hedgehog peeks out from under a table. The open tent flaps lead back to the pet show, where a rooster stands on a gray rock.

doors.label: Le concours
doors.hint: the open tent flaps, back to the pet show

salon.name: Le salon de thé · The tea salon
salon.alt: An elegant pink-striped tea salon with a crystal chandelier, little tea tables and a marble fireplace under a gilt mirror. A butler in tails bows to a grand old lady in lilac with a silver tea tray; a man with a monocle sniffs at his biscuits, pinky raised; a plump man in a purple waistcoat holds up a gilt portrait of himself; a lady in a feathered hat holds up a giant gold rosette over a small blue ribbon; a boy hiding under the tablecloth nets pink marshmallows off a cake stand; a man on the window seat watches through a brass telescope; a long-haired painter in sandals paints at an easel; a white poodle sleeps on a velvet footstool. A pink door with a gold teapot leads back to the blue music room, a yellow door with a red balloon opens onto a birthday party, and a black door with a silver camera opens onto a photo studio.

doors.label: Le salon de musique
doors.hint: the pink door with the gold teapot, back to the music room

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the yellow door with the red balloon, to the birthday party

doors.label: Le studio photo
doors.hint: the black door with the silver camera, to the photo studio

anniversaire.name: L'anniversaire · The birthday party
anniversaire.alt: A sunny sky-blue playroom with painted clouds, streamers and balloons. A young mother rocks a newborn baby in a rocking chair; a birthday girl in a paper crown sits among a huge pile of presents; a big dad on a seesaw lifts a tiny laughing girl high in the air; a ginger cat licks the frosting of the birthday cake; a grown man in a tie lies on the rug kicking and wailing in a tantrum; a fluffy puppy hugs a boy's ankle; a boy in a striped shirt rips the paper off a present, shreds flying. A yellow door with a red balloon leads back to the pink tea salon, and a mint-green door with a chess knight opens onto a game room.

doors.label: Le salon de thé
doors.hint: the yellow door with the red balloon, back to the tea salon

doors.label: La salle de jeux
doors.hint: the green door with the chess knight, to the game room

jeux.name: La salle de jeux · The game room
jeux.alt: A cozy wood-paneled game room with a red sofa, a wall of family photos and a glowing jukebox with a parrot on top. A girl in pigtails holds up a bright blue banana by a bowl of yellow ones; a bee wrapped in a fluffy pink towel sits on the windowsill; a white-haired grandpa clutches his throat as he croaks into a karaoke microphone; a girl cheers with red pompoms, hand on her throat; a boy in glasses lines up dominoes with a ruler; a girl grins as she makes her chess move while her brother stares. A mint-green door with a chess knight leads back to the birthday playroom.

doors.label: L'anniversaire
doors.hint: the green door with the chess knight, back to the birthday party

studio.name: Le studio photo · The photo studio
studio.alt: A bright white photo studio under a skylight, with umbrella lamps, a gray paper backdrop and pop-art portraits on the walls. A girl watches a photo slide out of her instant camera; a painter holds up a lifelike fish painting that a tabby cat stretches up to sniff; a photographer in a bow tie aims down from high on a stepladder; an assistant in a cap mounts an old camera on a tripod; a teenager in headphones pops a pink bubblegum bubble by a pop-art portrait; a dachshund poses on a velvet stool; a boy holds up a horseshoe magnet that pulls paper clips. A black door with a silver camera leads back to the tea salon, and a navy door with white stripes opens onto a gym.

doors.label: Le salon de thé
doors.hint: the black door with the silver camera, back to the tea salon

doors.label: La salle de gym
doors.hint: the navy door with white stripes, to the gym

gym.name: La salle de gym · The gym
gym.alt: A bright old-fashioned gym with a honey wooden floor, climbing ropes, wall bars and blue mats. A strongman in a striped leotard lifts a barbell with a laughing grandma sitting on each end; a frail old man in a gray tracksuit wobbles with tiny pink dumbbells; a girl in red climbs straight up a rope; a gymnast does a handstand on the parallel bars; a boy zips up a small stuffed gym bag on a mat; a coach with a whistle stands under the big wall clock, one eye twitching; a hamster in a sweatband runs in its wheel. A navy door with white stripes leads back to the photo studio, and green-framed glass doors open onto the conservatory.

doors.label: Le studio photo
doors.hint: the navy door with white stripes, back to the photo studio

doors.label: La serre
doors.hint: the glass doors, to the conservatory

serre.name: La serre · The conservatory
serre.alt: A sunlit glass conservatory with white iron frames, a brick floor, palms, ferns and terracotta pots around a little fountain with a frog on its rim. A gardener in green overalls lifts a giant orange pumpkin from the vegetable bed; a boy peeks out through a thick wall of ferns; a big tortoise ambles along the brick path with a flowerpot on its shell. Green-framed glass doors lead back to the gym, and white French doors under a green-and-white striped awning open onto a sunny terrace with a lunch table.

doors.label: La salle de gym
doors.hint: the glass doors, back to the gym

doors.label: La terrasse
doors.hint: the white French doors under the striped awning, to the family terrace

terrasse.name: La terrasse · The family terrace
terrasse.alt: A sunny flagstone terrace behind the house, with a long white-clothed lunch table under a plane tree, a stone balustrade with geraniums, a little round pool and rolling hills beyond. A teenage girl spoon-feeds a giggling baby in a high chair; a smiling mother and father swing their little son between them; a red-haired grandpa, dad and baby pose cheek to cheek; a mother duck leads five ducklings across the flagstones; a woman of about fifty dances the can-can in a red skirt; a girl in a straw hat bites an apple on the wall in the sun; a peacock fans its tail on the balustrade; a white-haired grandpa holds up an old photo of his young self. White French doors under a striped awning lead back to the conservatory, a red stable door opens into a kitchen and a dark-oak door with a carved book opens onto a library.

doors.label: La serre
doors.hint: the white French doors, back to the conservatory

doors.label: La cuisine
doors.hint: the red stable door, to the kitchen

doors.label: La bibliothèque
doors.hint: the dark-oak door with the carved book, to the library

cuisine.name: La cuisine · The kitchen
cuisine.alt: A cosy country kitchen with a blue-and-white tiled wall, copper pans over a cream range, a dresser of blue plates and a long wooden table. A round cook in a chef's hat flings his arms wide in welcome; a kind granny heaps baked beans onto a yawning boy's plate; a girl stands on a big watermelon to reach the cookie jar; a boy with chocolate round his mouth hangs his head as his aunt stands over him, hands on hips; a cook in a red headscarf tastes the soup at the range before salting it; two kittens doze in a basket. A red stable door leads back to the sunny terrace.

doors.label: La terrasse
doors.hint: the red stable door, back to the terrace

bibliotheque.name: La bibliothèque · The library
bibliotheque.alt: A tall dark-wood library with shelves to the ceiling, a rolling ladder with a dozing owl, a big globe, a green reading lamp and a tall arched window. A child in a white astronaut helmet reaches up for a red model rocket; a small boy sits on the rug pulling books from the lowest shelf; a boy in a leather armchair reads a dark book with his hair on end; a friendly see-through ghost glides out of the bookshelf; a librarian in a black tailcoat holds out a book on a silver tray; a bearded man in a sun hat lounges in a hammock. A dark-oak door with a carved book leads back to the terrace, a white door with a porthole and a green cross opens onto a nurse's room, and a turquoise shop door with a brass bell opens onto a gift shop.

boutique.name: La boutique · The gift shop
boutique.alt: A bright little museum gift shop with white shelves of snow globes and tote bags, a tall mirror, an umbrella stand and a wooden counter with a brass cash register and a goldfish in a crown. A woman in a flowered hat loaded with shopping bags tosses banknotes in the air; a boy holds up an Eiffel Tower snow globe; a peacock fans its tail before the mirror; a boy pulls a trail of paper clips with a big red magnet; a girl holds up a red polka-dot umbrella beside a stand of black ones; a shopkeeper fans a white cat on a velvet cushion; a small boy hands over one coin at the counter. A turquoise shop door with a brass bell leads back to the library.

infirmerie.name: L'infirmerie · The nurse's room
infirmerie.alt: A bright mint-green nurse's room with two white beds with checked blankets, a bandage cabinet, a skeleton model and a big window onto the garden. A nurse points at the skeleton's knee; a young helper takes a seated grandpa's blood pressure; a golden retriever rests its chin on a girl's blanket; a boy sneezes into a tissue as a girl leans away; a girl tickles her brother's plaster cast with a feather while he reads on; a boy holds up a bandaged finger; a teddy bear with a bandaged paw sits on the windowsill. A white door with a porthole and a green cross leads back to the library.
